en-US.description: This software allows you to create new notes simply by clicking anywhere on the window, providing a seamless and intuitive note-taking experience.
en-US.longDescription:
Experience the convenience of having all your notes on a single screen with Vovsoft Visual Notes. This software allows you to create new notes simply by clicking anywhere on the window, providing a seamless and intuitive note-taking experience.

Customize your notes by changing their color and size to suit your preferences. Plus, you have the option to save your notes as files for easy retrieval and restore them whenever needed. Whether you're brainstorming ideas or merging notes from various categories, this utility serves as a practical solution.

Give this program a try and elevate your note-taking experience to a whole new level.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Visual Notes
